name: Do I need a permit for railing repair in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for railing repair in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: For minor cosmetic railing repairs, a permit is typically not required. However, if the repair involves significant structural changes, an alteration to the railing's height or design, or affects the overall safety and egress of a structure, a building permit may be necessary in cities like Berkeley or Oakland. Frasheski Construction can help identify if your specific repair project will require local permits during our assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor cosmetic railing repairs usually don't need a permit. Significant structural changes or alterations affecting safety might require one in Berkeley or Oakland.
